HeartGold & SoulSilver series · CL

Call of Legends

Released February 9, 2011 · 106 cards

Call of Legends is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the HeartGold & SoulSilver series, released in English on February 9, 2011. Its main set has 95 cards, plus 11 secret rares numbered beyond the set (106 in total). It includes 86 Pokémon, 10 Trainer and 10 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.

Illustrators

28 illustrators worked on Call of Legends. Most cards: Ken Sugimori (8), Hideaki Hakozaki (6), Noriko Hotta (6), Ryo Ueda (6), Kouki Saitou (5), Suwama Chiaki (5), Ayaka Yoshida (4), Hajime Kusajima (4).
